fact: Guineenews reports that at the 4 September 2025 launch of the national Data Center (Tier III, 600 m2, built and presented by COREX), the telecommunications minister said Guinea's strategic data now stays in Guinea under state control, instead of being hosted abroad at over USD 5 million a year; the document does not name which ministries' systems are moved.

The Presidency states that Guinea inaugurated its first national data centre on 4 September 2025 and that the state's strategic data, previously hosted abroad at about USD 5 million a year, is now back under Guinean control.
At a 19 December 2025 validation workshop, consultant Emmanuel Elolo said Guinea's AI roadmap proposes a national data hub and a national sovereign cloud because state data are fragmented.
system: national sovereign cloud and data hub
